name: Workspace routing
description: One TanStack Router route at /, whose search parameters paneA, paneB and pane are the workspace, with repoA and repoB beside them naming each pane's repository by its identity or an untracked vault's registry name, never by a path. The address follows what the panes report; on a first load and on Back or Forward it leads, restoring through the workspace port with the same command the navigator runs, once the repositories are known. It is never board authority. Canonical model, scope, and checkpoint parameters describe each open pane directly, including unavailable readings. Pane closure removes those parameters. Back and reload restore them without altering legacy board command ownership. Canonical focus, hidden relationship kinds, and hidden group regions also belong to each pane address. Back, Forward, and reload restore them. Transient selection and camera state remain outside browser history. Each canonical pane also preserves diagram grammar and the explicitly selected flow. Grammar changes retain the preceding architecture scope, focus, and filters. Unavailable flow identities remain explicit. Canonical state and comparison selectors coexist with scope, focus, filters, grammar, and flow. Exact checkpoint and mutable state selection are mutually exclusive. History restores unavailable requested states without silently selecting Current. Explicit canonical addresses remain visible when the server remembers a legacy board. The existing operation owner reveals a deliberately opened legacy board. Navigation history uses the visible origin so repeated visits preserve the preview entry.

outgoing.label: restore through the workspace port, repository by pane
